result.summary: The intersection lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and dedicated pedestrian signals, despite being in a residential area. The wide roadway and lack of clear lane markings create a vehicle-oriented environment with high exposure for people crossing.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: No painted crosswalks exist at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path.
hazards.location_in_image: Across all legs of the intersection.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The intersection has vehicle traffic lights but no pedestrian-specific signals to indicate safe crossing times.
hazards.location_in_image: Mounted on the utility poles or mast arms.

hazards.name: Utility Pole Obstruction
hazards.description: A large utility pole is positioned directly at the corner, narrowing the available sidewalk space for pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground right corner.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time and improve safety at the signalized intersection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance, slow turning vehicles, and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential intersection with basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a traffic signal. However, the environment is degraded by faded crosswalk markings, poor pavement quality, and a lack of visible ADA-compliant curb ramps.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The existing crosswalk markings are heavily worn and difficult to see, reducing driver awareness of the crossing zone.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement Surface
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven roadway pavement within the intersection area can create tripping hazards for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style high-visibility crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps

result.summary: The intersection lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals, despite being controlled by a traffic light. Wide crossing distances and sightline obstructions from parked vehicles and mature trees increase risk for people walking in this residential area.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossings
hazards.description: No painted crosswalks are visible at the intersection, providing no designated path for pedestrians or warning to drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Across all legs of the intersection

hazards.name: Sightline Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles and large trees near the corners may block the view between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten crossing distances and prevent parking too close to the intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to the existing traffic signal infrastructure.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the intersection to improve visibility for all road users.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential intersection with row housing and a wide roadway. While sidewalks and a marked crosswalk are present, the environment lacks modern safety features such as high-visibility markings, curb extensions, or dedicated pedestrian signals.
